messages:
Amy (PM): quick sync — proposed micro-iteration to balance fixes vs follow-on polish after launch. 45% of incoming signal is regressions from streaming edge-case; 30% feature asks; rest ops/infra. recommend 2-week focused slice.
Sam (Eng): +1. can you share the slice list?
Amy (PM): putting it here, very small and opinionated: 
```
1) Streaming cutover crash (high) — rollback path + hotfix, owner @Sam, target MRS < 100ms
2) Prefix cache eviction bug (med) — fix + add unit test, owner @Sam, rollout to canary 10%
3) Customer snippet UX (low) — design polish, owner @Lina, behind feature flag
4) Billing export flaky rows (med) — backend fix, owner @Rajesh (CS to validate)
5) Regression test add: streaming + billing (qa) — owner @Jess
```
Jess (QA): ok. need clarity on acceptance for (1) — what counts as "fixed" in-prod?
Amy (PM): good call. acceptance for (1): no crashes in 24h at 100% traffic for the affected variant OR error rate <= 0.02% for 24h and synthetic replay shows 0 failures. update prod runbook entry.
Sam (Eng): timeline: (1) 1.5d to patch + 0.5d for canary, (2) 1d to patch + tests, (4) 1.5d. total ~4.5 dev days. we can parallelize (3) and (5).
Lina (Design): for (3) I can prototype a quick micro-interaction by EOD tomorrow. will keep it behind flag so no risk to rollout.
Rajesh (CS): I can validate billing rows with the customers that reported it after we have a canary build. suggest a 24h customer validation window.
Jess (QA): I'll add two new tests to the regression harness: one replay for the crash vector and one export end-to-end for billing rows. will need a dev seed and short repro case.
Amy (PM): tradeoffs: if we prioritize (3) UX over (1) crash we risk more customer complaints + potential SLA breaches. propose ordering: (1) > (4) & (2) parallel > (3) & (5) parallel.
Sam (Eng): agree. small ask: can we freeze non-critical infra changes for the slice? reduces noise for canary metrics.
Amy (PM): yes — enforce freeze on infra PRs for the slice window. I'll post a separate note to eng-infra.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary started 10% for commit abc123 on shard cluster-us-east-2
Jess (QA): saw canary alert at +20m, investigating.
Sam (Eng): timeline update: turned on extra logging for the crash path, will throttle if noise spikes.
Rajesh (CS): customer-facing comms: I'll draft a short note for affected customers explaining we're rolling a targeted fix this week and offering interim mitigation steps.
Lina (Design): small UX change looks fine behind the flag. no blocking concerns.
Amy (PM): decisions: owners assigned, acceptance criteria set, infra freeze for slice, canary plan in place. ask: react with :thumbsup: if you agree to the ordering and owners; :eyes: for questions. will consolidate and make a JIRA slice (will link here).
Sam (Eng): :thumbsup:
Jess (QA): :thumbsup:
Rajesh (CS): :thumbsup:
Lina (Design): :thumbsup:
Amy (PM): thanks — will open the jira + runbook updates now and ping release-war-room when canary hits 50% for final rollout check.
